## Findings
- claim-1: From artifact `621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602`, \(Q_d\) is torsion-free of ranks \(1,1,2,1,1\) in degrees \(6,7,8,9,10\), respectively. [artifact 621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602]
- claim-2: With quotient bases \[ B_6=(222),\ B_7=(2221),\ B_8=(2222,22211),\ B_9=(22221),\ B_{10}=(22222), \] the coordinates of \(G_L\) are the identity degreewise, while those of \(G_R\) are \[ [222]_{B_6}=(1),\quad [322]_{B_7}=(-1), \] \[ ([422]_{B_8},[332]_{B_8})= \begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}, \quad [432]_{B_9}=(-1),\quad[442]_{B_{10}}=(1). \] [artifact 621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602]
- claim-3: Thus the degreewise transition matrices \(T_d\), defined by \([G_R]_Q=[G_L]_Q\,T_d\), are \[ T_6=(1),\quad T_7=(-1),\quad T_8=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix},\quad T_9=(-1),\quad T_{10}=(1), \] each unimodular. [artifact 621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602]
## Strategy
Provisional ledger extraction:
\[
T_6=(1),\quad T_7=(-1),\quad T_8=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix},\quad T_9=(-1),\quad T_{10}=(1),
\]
for degreewise orders induced by the displayed \(G_L,G_R\). Their determinants are \(1,-1,-1,-1,1\).

The requested target is **not established**: these coordinates lack the required quotient-map/Smith-witness certificate.

## Gaps
Missing are ambient Schur-column orders, matrices \(M_d,U_d,V_d\), quotient maps \(C_d\), and family-selection matrices verifying
\[
C_dM_d^{T}=0,\qquad C_dL_d=I,\qquad C_dR_d=T_d
\]
for \(6\le d\le10\).
